description: 7 should-trigger + 6 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers specific product-fact claims (context window, pricing, rate limit, API detail, model spec, consumer-app plan limit) across OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Mistral, DeepSeek, Cohere. Should-not-trigger covers near-misses: SDK wiring with a user-supplied model, prompt authoring (prompt-engineering-patterns), model choice for the host (model-recommendation), image-provider selection (image-provider-routing), a user-supplied fact, and a plain SDK refactor.

queries.q: what's the context window of GPT-5?
how much does Gemini 2.5 Pro cost per million input tokens?
what are the rate limits on the Anthropic API for tier 1?
does the Mistral API support function calling, and what parameter enables it?
what's the max output length for DeepSeek's chat model?
how many messages does ChatGPT Plus allow in the app per window?
what embedding dimension does Cohere's embed model return?
wire up an openai chat completions call using the model id I already gave you
queries.note: SDK wiring; user supplied the model — no unverified product fact asserted

queries.q: write a good prompt to make Gemini summarize this document
which model should I use for this task on my current host?
queries.note: model choice → model-recommendation (never steer to another vendor)

queries.q: route this logo-with-text image to the right generation provider
I already know Claude Sonnet has a 200k context window — just use that number
queries.note: user supplied the verified fact; use it, do not re-litigate

queries.q: refactor this function that calls the Anthropic SDK to add retries
queries.note: plain code refactor; asserts no product fact
